conclusion.label: rejects

report:
### Conclusion

The claim that influenza vaccination causes Alzheimer's disease is unsupported by peer-reviewed scientific evidence and is false. 

Rather than causing cognitive decline, medical evidence consistently demonstrates that influenza vaccination is associated with a **decreased** risk of developing Alzheimer's disease and other forms of dementia. Large cohort studies show that older adults who receive an annual flu shot have lower rates of incident Alzheimer's dementia compared to unvaccinated individuals. Furthermore, recent studies indicate that receiving a high-dose flu shot offers even greater risk reduction compared to standard-dose vaccines.

* https://www.neurology.org/doi/10.1212/WNL.0000000000214782
* https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC9484126/
* https://aaic.alz.org/releases_2020/vaccines-dementia-risk.asp
